scientific_scope_status: Strict Laplace interior positivity is an exact source-reported existence criterion under the stated Banach-cone and compact-distribution hypotheses. It removes a quantitative exponential lower-margin assumption by adapting the radial kernel to the local margin. The scalar example separates the all-exponential-moment construction from every fixed exp(-c|x|log|x|) two-tail class. The explicit Q example has an all-point positive bound >0.183p while every positive smooth product kernel and every nondegenerate Gaussian fail. Novelty, external correctness, finite-cost compilation and practical capability remain UNKNOWN or unestablished.
